prompts.name: new_game
prompts.title: New game
prompts.description: Start a new game: create a project, build its scene through the editor, save and verify it.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name of the game, e.g. Tetris.

arguments.name: idea
arguments.description: What the game is about, in a sentence or two.

prompts.name: add_component_type
prompts.title: Add a Component type
prompts.description: Add a reflected Component type to the game module and use it in the scene.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Stable name of the type, e.g. tetris.Board.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Its fields and their types, e.g. "width: u32, height: u32".

result.description: Start a new game: create a project, build its scene through the editor, save and verify it.

content.text:
Create a new game called "Tetris" with the illusion editor: falling blocks

1. Read illusion://guide for units and entity references.
2. Create the project with project_create (template "3d-starter"), or open one with project_open.
3. Build the scene with entity_create (with Components), hierarchy_set_parent and transform_set; group related steps with editor_batch.
4. Save it with scene_save.
5. Verify it with scene_tree, entity_get and scene_info, and fix what differs.
